description:
Affected extension: status-line.ex
Upstream: ctx.ui.theme is a Theme object with fg(color, text) and bg(color, text) methods for applying named semantic colors (dim, accent, success, muted, etc.) to status strings.
Used by status-line.ts to produce colored status text: theme.fg('accent', '●') for the spinner, theme.fg('success', '✓') for complete, theme.fg('dim', ' Turn N...') for the label.
Current workaround: plain strings without ANSI styling.
What's needed: UIContext must expose a theme field (or get_theme fn returning a struct with color-application helpers). Integrates with the theme system (opi-m4h.1). The theme struct needs at least fg/2 and bg/2 that map semantic color names to ANSI escape sequences.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/status-line.ts (ctx.ui.theme.fg)
title: ctx.ui.theme — expose theme color palette to UIContext
